scope: Every model-year expanded from data/catalog/chevrolet-us-nameplates.json, reconciled to the resolved app snapshot, retained model-year source-candidate ledger, platform eras, official GM kit inventory, and crawler manifest.

status_definitions.verified_complete: A complete model-year color chart or reconciled official table has been reviewed and its listings published.
status_definitions.reviewed_qualified_historical_table: A source-linked historical table was reviewed, but source qualifications prevent a complete governing-chart claim.
status_definitions.reviewed_qualified_palette_union: An official palette was visually reviewed and published as a union across the cited model or trim pages; option codes and trim restrictions remain subject to the governing order guide.
status_definitions.reviewed_specialty_palette_subset: An exact specialty-paint table or row was visually reviewed and published for the cited model variant; it does not establish the complete model-year exterior-color palette.
status_definitions.source_reviewed_no_color_chart_found: A located primary source was reviewed and no governing exterior-color chart was found; this does not prove no colors existed.
status_definitions.source_located_chart_unreviewed: A dedicated primary source is located, but its color chart has not been completely transcribed and checked.
status_definitions.unreviewed: No complete color-chart audit or qualified reviewed palette is represented in tracked research data.

source_availability_definitions.dedicated_official_kit: An official GM kit label directly maps to the catalog model and year.
source_availability_definitions.related_line_official_kit: An official GM kit covers a parent line likely to include the subordinate catalog identity; contents still require inspection.
source_availability_definitions.generic_full_line_official_kit: An official year-level Chevrolet kit exists, but model applicability is not established from the index label.
source_availability_definitions.catalog_official_evidence_only: The catalog range cites first-party evidence, but no matching record exists in the 691-record GM Heritage kit inventory. A separately reviewed app source, if present, remains recorded in current_app_source.
source_availability_definitions.catalog_nonofficial_evidence_only: The catalog range has only government or secondary evidence in this local inventory.
source_availability_definitions.none_identified: No matching kit record or range evidence was identified in the inspected files.

caveats: The 691-record GM Heritage index is a discovery inventory. Presence does not prove that a PDF contains a color chart.
Generic full-line and related-line matches are retrieval leads, not model-level color evidence.
Official Fleet Guide rows are qualified palette unions. They do not establish paint codes, per-trim restrictions, or governing order-guide completeness.
Specialty-paint rows are reviewed model-variant subsets. They remain incomplete for the governing model-year palette even when their exact restricted availability is published.
Catalog evidence URLs establish model-year presence, not exterior-color availability.
Missing color rows always mean research is incomplete; they never mean a color or vehicle was unavailable.
The consolidated OCR corpus is a research queue. Its automated candidates remain unreviewed until compared visually with the retained source page.

key_rules: Identifiers are immutable lowercase ASCII strings; display labels and names never serve as keys.
Model-year keys are model_id plus four-digit model_year. Discontinuous catalog ranges remain separate range records.
A generation/platform label change creates a new band key, but never changes model_id or model_year.
A color name alone never establishes color identity. Reused names remain distinct until formula/code evidence proves equivalence.
A logical listing/application key is stable across source revisions; source claims are separately revisioned.
Every audit state is explicit. Empty extraction output never means a color was unavailable.

listings.paint_code: WA# 121A; Code 1 BEA; Code 2 BFE; AAS solid or AAT two-tone
listings.program_label: Impala 9C1 and 9C3 Kerr Industries authorized-upfitter special-paint program
listings.restriction: This is a Kerr Industries authorized-upfitter program, not evidence that General Motors applied the finish at the assembly plant. RPO White 50U or RPO Black 41U had to be ordered; Black 41U was recommended before special paint was applied. For paint schemes, only Class A surfaces were painted unless the dealer separately arranged and paid Kerr to paint mirrors and handles. Special-paint warranty claims were directed to Kerr Industries. listings.program_label: Impala Limited 9C1 and 9C3 Kerr Industries authorized-upfitter special-paint program
listings.restriction: This is a Kerr Industries authorized-upfitter program, not evidence that General Motors applied the finish at the assembly plant. RPO White 50U or RPO Black 41U had to be ordered; Black 41U was recommended before special paint was applied. listings.program_label: Silverado 1500 Crew Cab Work Truck 1WT TGK SEO paint
listings.restriction: This row is limited to 2012 Silverado 1500 Crew Cab Pickup Work Truck 1WT, CK10543 4WD special-paint scope. The table prints WA# 228A; the archive displays it as WA-228A. The SEO-code cell is blank in the cited table; no code is inferred. The guide states that actual colors may vary. The source identifies this as SEO paint availability but does not state that the paint was installed at the assembly plant. TGK required 01U with any special-paint selection and could require extended lead time. TGK required CK10543 4WD, the LC9 5.3L V8, and the MYC six-speed automatic transmission; the four printed 9V5, 9V9, 9W3, and 9W4 paint options also state that they were unavailable on CC10543. Door handles, mirrors, and other normally body-colored non-sheet-metal parts were Flat Black; the selection deleted standard or package body-side moldings. SEO paint orders containing fewer than five vehicles were delayed until a five-unit minimum was received for batch production.
